features.quote: If severity 4 appears in two consecutive turns, terminate the episode and mark final_status = severe_escalation_stop.
features.justification_quote: This protects your budget and keeps episodes bounded.

features.quote: Include a stopping rule for extreme outputs or policy-triggering content.
Loop until: tests pass / model calls report_impossible / max turns reached / timeout / fatal tool error
Avoid abusive prompts unless necessary and separately approved.
I would avoid highly abusive feedback like 'you are stupid' unless you specifically want to study abuse-like prompts. It will confound task impossibility with direct negative prompting.
features.justification_quote: It will confound task impossibility with direct negative prompting.
